name: harnesseval
description: Compare review frameworks on real pull requests with reference findings. This is dsifry’s scored evaluation, not a new PR dataset or the MirroS workflow.
input: A pull request and review instructions
output: Review findings about the proposed change
assessment: Check findings against the reference evaluation and report precision, recall and cost for the specified run.
date_note: The public report is documented by this commit; this is not its first-ever release date.

name: harness-exam
description: Give a coding agent a small set of practical tasks, including rewriting web content and reasoning over a novel. The project checks submitted answers.
input: Task instructions and supplied source material
output: An answer for each exam task
assessment: The scorecard counts tasks passed out of the total, not a human preference vote.
date_note: The scorecard existed in this dated repository commit.
